polyester.name: Polyester Stretch Ceiling
polyester.intro: An aesthetic, functional stretch membrane for new build and renovation alike. Tensioned cold by hand for a flawless, very matte finish — with acoustic and washable options built in.
polyester.summary: Cold-mounted polyester stretch ceiling with a very matte finish, seamless to 5.15 m and a 10-year warranty.

features.title: Cold installation
features.body: No heat guns, no drying time. The polyester membrane is tensioned cold and clipped into a perimeter profile — clean, fast and fume-free, even in occupied rooms.

features.title: A very matte finish
features.body: A deep, glare-free matte surface that reads like freshly painted plaster — without the cracks, flaking or repainting that come with it.

features.title: Acoustic & washable
features.body: Choose a micro-perforated, absorber-backed version to tame reverberation. Every finish wipes clean and resists humidity for 25 years.

polyester.colourChartNote: Every colour is available in standard and acoustic finishes.

pvc.name: PVC Film Stretch Ceiling
pvc.intro: A warmed PVC film tensioned on install — fully recyclable and easily removable. Replace a tired ceiling with a flawless new one in a single day.
pvc.summary: Heat-mounted PVC film stretch ceiling, 100% recyclable and removable, seamless to 6.4 m with a 10-year warranty.

features.title: Recyclable to raw material
features.body: The PVC system is fully recyclable back to raw material — a circular choice that is easy to remove and refit whenever you need to.

features.title: Backlight & print ready
features.body: Translucent films diffuse LED light evenly with no hotspots; any image, texture or starry sky can be printed edge-to-edge.

features.title: Removable & washable
features.body: Unclip for access to the services above, then re-tension in minutes. The film wipes clean and shrugs off humidity.

pvc.colourChartNote: Available in matte, satin, gloss, translucent and metallic finishes.

acoustic.name: Acoustic Stretch System
acoustic.intro: A micro-perforated stretch membrane backed with high-density absorbers — a flawless ceiling that measurably cuts reverberation and noise in any room.
acoustic.summary: Micro-perforated acoustic stretch membrane with high-density absorber backing, reaching up to Class A sound absorption.

features.title: Class A absorption
features.body: High-density polyester wool behind a micro-perforated face delivers up to Class A sound absorption with no visible treatment.

features.title: Islands & wall panels
features.body: Free-hanging baffles and decorative wall absorbers extend the same system to any surface in the room.

features.title: Invisible audio
features.body: Loudspeakers mount completely behind the film for clean, sourceless sound that fills the space.

light.name: Illuminated Ceiling
light.intro: Translucent stretch films that turn an entire ceiling into a soft, even light source — or a printed canvas of any image you choose.
light.summary: Translucent backlit stretch ceilings and edge-to-edge printed designs, including fibre-optic starry-sky finishes.

features.title: Even backlighting
features.body: A translucent film over an LED field diffuses light with no hotspots — a luminous sky in any room, dimmable to suit the mood.

features.title: LED line lighting
features.body: Recessed light lines integrate seamlessly into the membrane for crisp, architectural lighting effects.

features.title: Printed designs
features.body: Any photograph, pattern or texture printed edge-to-edge — including a fibre-optic starry-sky night ceiling.

prefab.name: Prefab Structures
prefab.intro: Prefab carrier structures for stretch-ceiling projects — aluminium, steel and wood beams, coving and height-difference details, made to measure in our Polish production and shipped worldwide to our dealers.
prefab.summary: Made-to-measure prefab structures in aluminium, steel and wood — beams for raster ceilings, coving for floating ceilings, and clean height-difference details.

features.title: Built off-site
features.body: Modules are confectioned in our Belgian workshop and quality-checked before they ever reach the site.

features.title: Click-fit on site
features.body: Pre-tensioned units click into a perimeter frame — minimal trades, minimal time, a perfect result.

features.title: Integrated access
features.body: Discreet inspection hatches keep the services above reachable without breaking the clean ceiling line.

starry.name: Starry Sky Ceiling
starry.intro: A stretch ceiling scattered with hundreds of fibre-optic points — a calm, twinkling night sky over your cinema, bedroom or spa.
starry.summary: Fibre-optic and LED starry-sky stretch ceilings: hundreds of dimmable star points, optional shooting stars and RGB, on a seamless membrane.

features.title: A real night sky
features.body: Hundreds of fibre-optic points are set behind a tensioned membrane to create a deep, twinkling star field — mapped to a constellation or scattered at random.

features.title: Fibre-optic & LED
features.body: A single LED light engine drives every fibre, so the stars stay cool and fully dimmable. Add a twinkle wheel for movement, RGB for colour, or shooting-star effects.

features.title: Cinema, bedroom, spa
features.body: Perfect where you want atmosphere without glare — home cinemas, bedrooms, spas and restaurants. Combine with an acoustic backing for a calm, quiet room.

hatch.name: Inspection Hatch
hatch.intro: Discreet, serviceable access through a stretch ceiling — reach valves, junction boxes and fittings without cutting or replacing the membrane.
hatch.summary: Integrated inspection hatches for stretch ceilings: near-invisible, re-openable access to services hidden above the membrane, in any size.

features.title: Invisible until you need it
features.body: The hatch frame is built into the perimeter detailing and finished in the same membrane, so it disappears into the ceiling until it has to be opened.

features.title: Service without damage
features.body: Reach shut-off valves, junction boxes, dampers and light fittings hidden above the ceiling — and close it all up again, as many times as needed.

features.title: Any size, any room
features.body: From a small round access point to a large rectangular panel, sized to the service behind it. Works in new installs and as a retrofit into existing ceilings.

print.name: Custom Print Ceiling
print.intro: Any photograph, artwork or pattern printed edge-to-edge across a seamless stretch ceiling — your image, wall to wall, with no visible join.
print.summary: Edge-to-edge printed stretch ceilings: any high-resolution image, photo or brand graphic across a seamless membrane, optionally backlit.

features.title: Your image, edge to edge
features.body: Supply a photo, illustration, brand graphic or pattern and we print it across the full membrane — colour-managed and seamless, with no panel lines.

features.title: Print plus backlight
features.body: Combine a translucent film with an LED field to backlight the print, turning artwork or a sky scene into a soft, glowing feature ceiling.

features.title: Made to your space
features.body: Artwork is scaled and positioned to your exact room. We proof the file with you before production, so what you approve is what goes up.
